content.description: . . . ROLE. Associate / Lead / Program Manager – Strategy/Planning. WHO WE ARE. Rivigo is a technology company and a crowned unicorn founded in 2014, which is revolutionizing logistics & goods mobility in India with its unique, global-first relay trucking model. With a strong interplay of data, technology, operational excellence, and culture, we aim to make logistics faster, safer, cost-effective, and human.. Since we embarked on our journey of making logistics human, our ever-evolving, passionate, ambitious, and bold team has been relentlessly working towards this pursuit. Our purpose will be fulfilled through implementation of relay at scale, which would ensure a better life for our pilots, limitless growth and scale for our fleet partners, and reliable supply for our customers. We strongly believe that the biggest celebration of human life is elimination of drudgery, and that's exactly what we aim to achieve through our innovations at Rivigo.. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR. B.E/B.Tech from a Premium Engineering Institute (IITs, NITs, BITS Pilani, DCE, NSIT, BIT Mesra, etc.) or MBA grad from Tier-I MBA college, with 1-4 years of experience in consulting / ops excellence / ops analytics roles. Exceptional problem-solver with a demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives, who can take complete ownership of key workstreams to solve the complex challenges within a highly nuanced industry. Substantial experience in program/project management or an equivalent operational role. Ability to interpret, analyse, and understand complex data sets. Ability to influence stakeholders across the organization without direct reporting lines. Proven experience and knowledge of process improvement tools, methods, and techniques like 6/Sigma will be a plus. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR. Applying analytical expertise on operations to conceptualize projects, build stakeholder alignment, and drive projects to achieve strategic goals / rationalize cost & quality performance. Developing and maintaining operational excellence project plans, managing resources, identifying, prioritizing, and implementing initiatives to improve productivity, quality, customer service, and reducing costs and complexity. Leading the product development lifecycle end to end, starting from understanding the problems at hand, empathizing with the user to ensure the adoption post product launches, driving innovation, and conceptualizing new products from scratch – all of which requires challenging the status quo, going deep into data, persistently digging for improvement opportunities, and thinking boldly. Managing large and highly complex programs that will accelerate operational productivity and customer experience improvement across the organization. Fuelling a passion for operational excellence within operations teams. Join us to write the future of an entire sector and contribute to building the new India.. . . Show more. . . Show less. . . .
